in_marathi.name: Bharavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of poetry
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharavi is a name of the ancient Sanskrit poetess, revered for her profound works. She is said to be a goddess of poetry and the muse for artists and writers.
